summary: Regulatory role that reviews permit applications for completeness, derives limits and conditions from technical standards and the record, drafts enforceable permits and fact sheets, negotiates conditions, answers comments and administers issued permits, often within a delegated programme. Drafting software compresses production; review of drafted conditions grows.
evidenceNotice: Reshaping claims are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). No task has a v2 multi-rater assessment yet, so every task shows 'assessment pending'. Change indicators count active signals only (ADR-0028); all linked signals are at watch, so no change indicator moves. v1 values appear only as prior-evidence pointers.
